Hi Sofia —

Apologies for the delay; consolidated recommendations below based on our eval harness best practices and what will be safe for a canary-first rollout. This is our proposed implementation checklist with thresholds and rollback policy — open to tweaks from your security and SRE teams.

1) Prompt sets and regression signals
- We will import novuscare-promptset-v1.csv into the eval harness as the baseline. V1.1 should include ~200 edge prompts you highlighted; target: 2026-10-08.
- Primary signals we track: top-1 intent accuracy (when available), semantic similarity to reference responses (embedding cosine), hallucination flag rate (QA heuristics), and latency P95.

2) Recommended alert thresholds (initial, can be tuned during staging)
- Intent accuracy drop: >= 6% absolute decrease vs baseline over a 30m rolling window.
- Embedding similarity: median cosine drop >= 0.08 vs baseline across sampled prompts.
- Hallucination flag rate: >= 4% absolute increase across the promptset (we’ll surface examples).
- Latency P95: increase > 250ms over baseline AND sustained for 10 minutes.

3) Canary rollout plan (1–2 weeks)
- Week 0 (staging): eval harness connected, smoke tests run against canary model variant (no production traffic).
- Week 1 (canary): 5% of traffic routed to canary for 72 hours, with continuous sampling and nightly regression reports to both teams.
- Week 2 (ramp): if no alerts or only low-severity signals, ramp 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 72h increments.

4) Automated rollback triggers (hard)
- Any single-hour window with intent accuracy drop >= 10% OR hallucination increase >= 8% triggers automated rollback to the previous stable model variant and opens an incident with both teams.
- Any latency P95 increase > 500ms for 30 minutes triggers immediate rollback.
- If two or more medium-severity alerts occur within a 24h window (e.g., accuracy drop 6–9%, hallucination 4–7%), we pause the ramp and open a postmortem cadence.

5) Alerting and ownership
- Alerts posted to NovusCare – #nova-qmon (Slack) and Redwood – #qmon-nd-0448.
- Aditya will own tuning of the heuristic thresholds for hallucination flags and will run an initial calibration job during staging.
- Priyom will implement the staging webhook for your on-prem connector (we’ll provide the spec).

6) Deliverables & dates (proposed)
- Promptset v1.1 finalization: 2026-10-08 (Sofia + NovusCare PM)
- Eval harness staging connection: 2026-10-15 (Redwood engineering + NovusCare infra)
- Canary start: 2026-10-22

If NovusCare agrees, we’ll add these to the mutual-action-plan spreadsheet and create the canary runbook (incident playbook + rollback steps).

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-min tech sync with Priyom and NovusCare infra for 10/14 unless you prefer a different slot.
